summary: i-80 Gold Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the termination of its Amended and Restated Offtake Agreement with Vox Royalty Cayman SEZC and entry into an Offtake Termination and Settlement Agreement on June 25, 2026. Under the settlement, i-80 will issue 3,453,237 common shares valued at $4,800,000 to Vox Royalty Corp. as consideration for terminating the agreement that obligated i-80 to sell up to 40,000 ounces of refined gold per year. The shares will be offered via a prospectus supplement to its existing S-3 shelf registration. The opinion of Stikeman Elliott LLP on share legality is included. This is a contractual settlement rather than a transformative event.
